title: Plan a Proxmox maintenance assessment
summary: Prepare the existing check-mode maintenance assessment with explicit private recovery and availability policy.

target.description: Explicit target name from the private CmdMesh environment

expected_results: A static check-mode plan bound to this recipe, operation metadata and private inputs
No provider, Ansible, Terraform or infrastructure change runs during planning

known_failures.summary: The current recipe refuses package maintenance while guests run
next_checks: Inspect current guests and the configured assessment/apply scope
recovery: Use a separately owned guest procedure; this recipe does not stop or migrate guests

known_failures.summary: Host upgrade or reboot prerequisites are not established
next_checks: Verify console, backups, quorum, repositories and recovery ownership
recovery: Remain in assessment and follow the documented recovery procedure; do not retry reboots blindly

provenance.qualification: Local manifest, plan and role syntax contracts
limitations: Assessment/check mode does not prove a later upgrade or reboot will succeed
The current stopped-guest apply rule belongs to this recipe; it is not a universal submission hold
